measured.cap: 8192 descriptor items (largest bare filler that parses; 8193 is refused with descriptor_item_limit)
measured.items_per_instance_required_items_only: list entry or slot key + Md + required kind items + enab: drop_shadow 3, inner_shadow 3, outer_glow 4, inner_glow 5, bevel 16, colour_overlay 3, satin 3, stroke 5
measured.items_per_instance_every_key_the_importe: drop_shadow 28, inner_shadow 27, outer_glow 29, inner_glow 30, bevel 46, colour_overlay 24, satin 27, stroke 28
measured.contour: a contour point costs 4 items (list entry, Hrzn, Vrtc, Cnty); Folio holds up to 256 points, so a drop shadow with a 256-point contour costs 28 + 4 x 254 = 1044 items
measured.most_instances_one_descriptor_holds_in_l: required items only: drop_shadow 2728, inner_shadow 2728, colour_overlay 2728, stroke 1637; every key with a 2-point contour: drop_shadow 292, inner_shadow 303, colour_overlay 341, stroke 292; drop shadow with a 256-point contour: 7. Outer glow, inner glow, bevel and satin have no multi list (one per slot unless a key is repeated), so only their cost is stated
measured.thresholds: 1 live + 1024 switched off (1025 instances, the smallest stack Folio's ceiling cuts) does not fit 8192 items from 8 items per instance; a full 512-entry list from 16 items per instance; 65 live instances (smallest stack over the 64 per-layer limit) from 127 items per instance
measured.which_cap_fires_first: required-items-only instances (3 to 5 items; bevel 16 sits in a single slot) stay under 8, so the ceiling cut (1024) and the 512-entry list cap are reached before the 8192 cap, and the 64 per-layer limit before it as well; instances with every key the importer reads (24 to 46 items) are past 8 and 16, so for them the 8192 cap fires first: before the ceiling (a stack holds 292 to 341 instances, not 1025) and before a full 512-entry list; the 64 per-layer limit is reached first for them (292 > 64) unless the instance costs 127 or more items (a drop shadow with a contour of 27 points or more: 28 + 4 x 25 = 128), then the stack is lost with descriptor_item_limit instead of effects_over_budget (pinned at 126/127 items by the test). Photoshop-authored items per instance are UNVERIFIED (no Photoshop-authored fixture, no outbound read); the figures cover the keys the importer reads, a real instance may carry more unread keys and cost more
